lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Excuse me for suddenly asking,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but how do you feel about us fighting together?
Not bad.
It looks like we're not really in sync.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I didn't expect that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I thought you'd say something like we don't obey your orders

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: or that we have no respect

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: as usual, and blah blah blah.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I think our coordination will get better after getting along for a while.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: After all, we either win our battles, or we die.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: yet here we are, the two of us out here together.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Still, I am looking forward to working with you, Commander.
Then, what do you think of me?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You mean, my opinion of you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't have much of an opinion.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It doesn't matter if our minds are in sync or if we get along or not.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: what I do care about is that one of us might die soon LOL
No one will die.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I sure hope so.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There's nothing better I can hope for than to survive together.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Let's pray for our future

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: and wish ourselves good luck, Commander.
Good luck!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: All right!
